g.text: Quincy came to me and said the absolutely strangest thing. That you wanted to talk to me... about your 'feelings?'
I really just wanted to apologize for the terrible things I said.
I just wanted to tell you that I have feelings for you.
Well... seems like a poor choice for me to hold a grudge given our situation. If you mean it? I forgive you.
And... truth be told? I can't help but admit that I've been harbouring some feelings for you...
And I would be keen to remind you that you had your chance.
And why have you kept this to yourself until now?
If you're serious about wanting to give 'this' a go, between us? I'd be willing to do the same.
But I'd also be lying if I didn't admit that I missed you and would be willing to give this another go, if you were.
Maybe I've been confused on how this all works.
Seems so. Well. If you'd like to give 'this' a go, I would be more than happy to.
